metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. FUJIFILM data sheet AF3-121E (2002-07 (print code EIGI-02.7)), Fujicolor-Portrait-Film-NPH-400-Professional-_AF3-121E.pdf, PDF page(s) 8, FUJICOLOR PORTRAIT FILM NPH 400 PROFESSIONAL [NPH] (2002): https://filmcolors.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Fujicolor-Portrait-Film-NPH-400-Professional-_AF3-121E.pdf (catalogued at https://filmcolors.org/timeline-entry/40681/) Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): base+fog and mid-scale dye densities read from the sheet, individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder (not printed); spectral sensitivity on a relative log scale (one log unit = the interval marked '1.0'), absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives). Original data are property of the respective holders.
